name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Tate Press
description: A unilateral variation of the Tate press targeting the triceps with a single dumbbell. The lifter lies on a bench and lowers one dumbbell in a unique arc to the chest, emphasizing the medial and lateral tricep heads. Greater range is achievable unilaterally.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Single-Arm Dumbbell Tate Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Single-Arm Dumbbell Tate Press.
steps: Step 1: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell with elbow flared to side.
Step 2: Lower dumbbell in arc toward same-side chest keeping elbow wide.
Step 3: Touch dumbbell lightly to chest at bottom of movement.
Step 4: Press back up through tricep extension to lockout.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
